descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A2 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Status and errors are not announced: errors, 'no results', Ask AI answers and 'Listening…' are silent for screen readers; toggles expose no selected/pressed state

Tickets: TFA-94745 etc. · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-09/S23

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S18 Dictation controls and states are announced (axe, WCAG 2 A/AA)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Dictation never leaves the physician waiting with nothing: a start or finish that fails is retried and then shown as a clear message, and the AI call time is logged separately from the total. (UAT 3.5)
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 4)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual-lane fixture; Hospital pre-round editor and Nursing Home pre-round box

When Run axe with the Dictate control idle, while the session starts ('Hearing: Preparing dictation…' in the pre-round editors), 'Listening…', 'Transcribing…', and with the Recover notice shown

Then No serious or critical violations; Dictate/Stop has an accessible name and a pressed state; each state text is announced (role=status), not shown by colour alone; any future drug-name flag is perceivable without colour

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core serious/critical = 0 per state (visual-checks.ts); live-region announcement of the state change is recorded, not covered by axe. 'Wait until dictation is ready…' exists only in ListeningIndicator (Fix by voice, add-patient), not on these two surfaces, so it is not expected here

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

A screen-reader user cannot tell whether dictation is on (the Dictate/Stop button exposes no pressed state and 'Listening…' is not announced), and the red Stop button is low in contrast.

Evidence: allure-results/c857689b…: 6 pass / 48 fail across 3 profiles. Dictate/Stop has no aria-pressed in either pre-round editor. The Preparing / Listening / Recover texts are not in live regions (recorded only). The red Stop button and the 'Hearing:' label are at 3.8:1 contrast.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S18

Dictation controls and states are announced (axe, WCAG 2 A/AA)

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: partly): preround.spec.ts: cloud dictation fully scripted (prepareSession held → 'Preparing'; answered 'batch' with a synthetic oscillator microphone → 'Listening'; transcribeAudio held → 'Transcribing'; failed → Recover) in the Hospital editor and the NH box; axe per state, Dictate/Stop name + aria-pressed; live-region of each state recorded (oracle: recorded). — Announcement by a real screen reader and a real microphone are device checks; the state's live region is recorded, not judged, per the oracle.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 6 judged check(s) passed, 48 failed. All five states reached on all three profiles with cloud dictation fully scripted at the socket and a synthetic microphone: idle, 'Preparing dictation…', 'Listening…', 'Transcribing…', and the Recover notice (both contexts). State text in a live region is recorded (oracle: recorded, not judged).

Product issue: Dictate/Stop has no pressed state (aria-pressed) in either pre-round editor; its state is conveyed only by its label switching Dictate → Stop (and the editor title 'Listening…'), while the oracle asks for a name and a pressed state. The Preparing / Listening / Recover texts are not in live regions (recorded, per the oracle). The red Stop button and 'Hearing:' label fail contrast (3.8:1).

Evidence: 7 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-23_S18 — a folder (63 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
